backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking YouTube autoplay features to useHiddenYouTube.ts with metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries of multiple frontend source files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variable definitions for light/dark modes with global styling utilities.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component assembling sections, managing modal and heart explosion state, and wiring hidden audio and YouTube players.
frontend/src/components/valentine/Ambien: Renders sparkle canvas and floating hearts as a fixed ambient background layer.
frontend/src/components/valentine/CTASec: CTA section with a styled button triggering a parent-provided onClick handler.
frontend/src/components/valentine/FadeIn: Wrapper that applies fade-in animations when scrolled into view using useInView.
frontend/src/components/valentine/Floati: Generates animated floating heart elements with randomized positions and timings.
frontend/src/components/valentine/Footer: Simple footer with glowing romantic sign-off text.
frontend/src/components/valentine/Glowin: Animated typing-effect name with glow, pulse, zoom, and sparkles.
frontend/src/components/valentine/HeartE: Creates a burst of animated hearts radiating outward when triggered.
frontend/src/components/valentine/HeroSe: Hero section with floating hearts, glowing name, and introductory romantic text.
frontend/src/components/valentine/Hidden: Renders two hidden audio elements and exposes a switch callback using useHiddenVideoAudio.
Off‑screen YouTube player container initialized via useHiddenYouTube.
frontend/src/components/valentine/LoveLe: Glass-card love letter section with typewriter text and auto-scrolling behavior.
Glass-style modal with ESC support, backdrop, and click-outside-to-close handling.
frontend/src/components/valentine/NameSp: Generates small animated sparkles around the name with randomized positions.
frontend/src/components/valentine/Sparkl: Canvas particle system rendering animated sparkles with resize handling and rAF loop.
frontend/src/components/valentine/Visibl: Empty file with no implemented component.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates a backend actor using the current Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useHiddenVideoAudio.t: Manages two hidden audio elements, starting playback on first user interaction and allowing a switch to a second track.
frontend/src/hooks/useHiddenYouTube.ts: Loads the YouTube IFrame API and initializes a hidden player that can autoplay after user interaction.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity context with login, logout, and identity persistence using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useInView.ts: Provides a ref and boolean indicating whether the element is visible using IntersectionObserver.
frontend/src/hooks/useTypewriter.ts: Returns progressively revealed text over time to simulate a typewriter effect.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, custom CSS variables, gradients, animations, and styled utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme extensions, custom colors, animations, and plugin usage.
project_state.json: Tracks project version, design constraints, audio-handling requirements, and conflicting issues for a Valentine’s themed website. Lists known bugs and feature notes focused on media playback, UI preservation, and recent requirement changes.
